source: Pulled from tailwind.config.js, vite.config.js (PWA manifest) and src/index.css. There was no brand folder before this run.

sprites.sheet: 1024x1024, 4x4 grid, 256px frames, 16 frames per state. The app draws each frame at 128 CSS px (src/components/rex/PixelRexCharacter.jsx) and scales it with a CSS transform.
sprites.style: Painted, soft-edged illustration. Not pixel art.
sprites.roster: Only the ids in src/data/characters.js. The folder also holds sheets for characters that are not in the app (finn, luna, masha, rex, sparky, stella, zen); never use those.
